name: todo-ledger
description: Shared markdown todo lists. Humans and agent sessions create ledgers, claim items, and complete them — one source of truth across all sessions.
author: qihang-dai
highlights: Markdown-native: every ledger is a plain .md file with GFM checkboxes
Safe concurrency: CAS version guard on edits, atomic per-item claim for agents
Many sessions, one list: agents claim unclaimed items server-side, no double work

crons.name: pickup
crons.message: Follow the SOP at skills/todo-ledger/sops/pickup.md: use the todo-ledger CLI to claim up to 3 unclaimed items, do the work for each, then transition them. If claim returns no items, produce NO output and stop.
